title: ORIX USA’s Real Estate Investment Strategies Group Provides a $19 Million Senior Mortgage Loan for the Refinancing of Niima Apartments

body_markdown:
ORIX USA’s[Real Estate Investment Strategies](https://www.orix.com/real-estate/real-estate-investment-strategies/) group announced the closing of a $19 million senior mortgage loan to support Hub & Spoke Communities for the refinancing of Niima Apartments. Niima is a newly constructed mixed-use multifamily community located in San Diego’s North Park neighborhood, featuring 55 studio and one-bedroom residences and approximately 2,826 square feet of ground-floor restaurant space. The property features distinctive loft-style residences with exposed wood ceilings, expansive windows and modern finishes.


“Niima Apartments is a distinctive residential asset in one of San Diego’s premier urban infill neighborhoods, and this transaction builds on our existing relationship with Hub & Spoke Communities,” said[Stephen Klufas](https://www.orix.com/people/stephen-klufas/) , Managing Director, ORIX USA. “The financing reflects our ability to provide flexible capital solutions that support high-quality properties through different stages of their lifecycle.”
